source.text: לְמַ֤עַן צִיּוֹן֙ לֹ֣א אֶחֱשֶׁ֔ה וּלְמַ֥עַן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶשְׁק֑וֹט עַד־יֵצֵ֤א כַנֹּ֨גַהּ֙ צִדְקָ֔הּ וִישׁוּעָתָ֖הּ כְּלַפִּ֥יד יִבְעָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] sake of Zion not I will be silent, and for [the] sake of Jerusalem not I will be quiet, until goes out like the brightness her righteousness, and her salvation like a torch [that] burns.

en.L: For the sake of Zion I will not be silent, \q and for the sake of Jerusalem I will not be quiet, \q until her righteousness goes out like brightness, \q and her salvation like a torch [that] burns.
en.B: Because of Zion I will not be silent, \q and because of Jerusalem I will not keep still, \q until her righteousness breaks out like daybreak \q and her salvation burns like a torch.
en.R: I will not stay silent for the sake of Zion. \q I will not keep quiet for the sake of Jerusalem. \q I will keep speaking until her righteousness shines out like the morning light, \q and her salvation blazes like a burning torch.

es.L: Por amor de Sion no callaré, \q y por amor de Jerusalén no descansaré, \q hasta que salga como resplandor su justicia, \q y su salvación como antorcha [que] arde.
es.B: Por causa de Sion no me quedaré callado, \q y por causa de Jerusalén no estaré quieto, \q hasta que su justicia irrumpa como la aurora \q y su salvación arda como una antorcha.
es.R: No me quedaré callado por amor a Sion. \q No guardaré silencio por amor a Jerusalén. \q Seguiré hablando hasta que su justicia brille como la luz de la mañana, \q y su salvación arda como una antorcha encendida.

fr.L: À cause de Sion je ne me tairai pas, \q et à cause de Jérusalem je ne resterai pas tranquille, \q jusqu’à ce que sa justice sorte comme l’éclat, \q et son salut comme une torche qui brûle.
fr.B: Pour l’amour de Sion je ne me tairai pas, \q et pour l’amour de Jérusalem je ne resterai pas en repos, \q jusqu’à ce que sa justice paraisse comme le point du jour \q et que son salut brûle comme une torche.
fr.R: Je ne resterai pas silencieux, à cause de Sion. \q Je ne me tairai pas, à cause de Jérusalem. \q Je continuerai à parler jusqu’à ce que sa justice brille comme la lumière du matin \q et que son salut flambe comme une torche allumée.

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya Sayuni sitanyamaza, \q na kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu sitatulia, \q mpaka haki yake itokeze kama mwangaza, \q na wokovu wake kama mwenge [unaowaka].
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya Sayuni sitanyamaza, \q na kwa sababu ya Yerusalemu sitakaa kimya, \q mpaka haki yake ichomoze kama mapambazuko \q na wokovu wake uwake kama mwenge.
sw.R: Sitanyamaza kwa ajili ya Sayuni. \q Sitakaa kimya kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu. \q Nitaendelea kusema mpaka haki yake ing'ae kama mwanga wa asubuhi, \q na wokovu wake uwake kama mwenge unaowaka.

decisions.choice: I: the speaker is probably the prophet, the anointed one who spoke in 61:1-11; it may be the LORD
decisions.reason: Chapter 61 ends with the anointed speaker's song, and 62:1 continues in the first person. But God also says he has kept silent and will not keep silent (42:14; 57:11; 65:6), and in 62:6 the speaker appoints watchmen. The verse does not name the speaker.

decisions.choice: her righteousness: her being put right by God, her vindication, made visible to all
decisions.reason: Paired with salvation, righteousness here is the right standing God gives Zion when he rescues her, as in 46:13, 51:5 and 61:11. Verse 2 says the nations will see it.

decisions.choice: like brightness, like a burning torch: plain for everyone to see
decisions.reason: The light of dawn and a burning torch both shine out where all can see them; Zion's restoration will not be hidden (60:1-3).

source.text: וְרָא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ צִדְקֵ֔ךְ וְכָל־מְלָכִ֖ים כְּבוֹדֵ֑ךְ וְקֹ֤רָא לָךְ֙ שֵׁ֣ם חָדָ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִקֳּבֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will see nations your righteousness, and all kings your glory, and it will be called to you a name new which the mouth of Yahweh will designate it.

en.L: And nations will see your righteousness, \q and all kings your glory; \q and you will be called [by] a new name \q which the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will designate.
en.B: Nations will see your righteousness \q and every king your glory. \q You will be given a new name, \q one that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will pronounce with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own mouth.
en.R: The nations will see your righteousness, \q and all their kings will see your glory. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} will speak a new name for you, \q and that is what you will be called.

es.L: Y las naciones verán tu justicia, \q y todos los reyes tu gloria; \q y te llamarán [con] un nombre nuevo \q que la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} señalará.
es.B: Las naciones verán tu justicia \q y todos los reyes tu gloria. \q Recibirás un nombre nuevo, \q uno que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} pronunciará con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia boca.
es.R: Las naciones verán tu justicia, \q y todos sus reyes verán tu gloria. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo pronunciará un nombre nuevo para ti, \q y así te llamarán.

fr.L: Et les nations verront ta justice, \q et tous les rois ta gloire ; \q et on t’appellera d’un nom nouveau \q que la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} désignera.
fr.B: Les nations verront ta justice \q et tous les rois ta gloire. \q On te donnera un nom nouveau, \q que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prononcera de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre bouche.
fr.R: Les nations verront ta justice, \q et tous leurs rois verront ta gloire. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} te donnera un nom nouveau, \q et c’est ainsi qu’on t’appellera.

sw.L: Na mataifa wataiona haki yako, \q na wafalme wote utukufu wako; \q nawe utaitwa [kwa] jina jipya \q ambalo kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kitalitaja.
sw.B: Mataifa yataiona haki yako \q na kila mfalme utukufu wako. \q Utapewa jina jipya, \q ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atalitamka kwa kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} mwenyewe.
sw.R: Mataifa yataiona haki yako, \q na wafalme wao wote wataona utukufu wako. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} atakupa jina jipya, \q nalo ndilo utakaloitwa.

decisions.choice: your, you: Zion herself, now addressed directly
decisions.reason: Verse 1 spoke about Zion; from here the speaker turns to her and speaks to her as a woman (feminine forms), as in 60:1-22.

decisions.choice: a new name: a new identity and standing, given by the LORD himself
decisions.reason: In the Bible a new name marks a new relationship or calling (Genesis 17:5; 32:29). Verses 4 and 12 give Zion's new names, and 65:15 promises God's servants another name; Revelation 2:17 and 3:12 take up the promise.

decisions.choice: designate: name exactly, pronounce
decisions.reason: The verb means to mark out or specify by name (Genesis 30:28; Numbers 1:17). The name is not one people invent but one God himself pronounces.

source.text: וְהָיִ֛יתְעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּיַד־יְהוָ֑ה וּצְנִ֥יף מְלוּכָ֖ה בְּכַף־אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will be a crown of beauty in [the] hand of Yahweh, and a turban of royalty in [the] palm of your God.

en.L: And you will be a crown of beauty in the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and a royal turban in the palm of your God.
en.B: You will be a beautiful crown held in the hand of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q a king's turban resting in the palm of your God.
en.R: You will be like a beautiful crown that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} holds in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q You will be like a king's turban in the hand of your God.

es.L: Y serás corona de hermosura en la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y diadema real en la palma de tu Dios.
es.B: Serás una hermosa corona sostenida en la mano {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q un turbante real que descansa en la palma de tu Dios.
es.R: Serás como una hermosa corona que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sostiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano. \q Serás como el turbante de un rey en la mano de tu Dios.

fr.L: Et tu seras une couronne de splendeur dans la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et un turban royal dans la paume de ton Dieu.
fr.B: Tu seras une couronne magnifique dans la main {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q un turban de roi posé dans la paume de ton Dieu.
fr.R: Tu seras comme une belle couronne que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} tient dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. \q Tu seras comme un turban de roi dans la main de ton Dieu.

sw.L: Nawe utakuwa taji la uzuri mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na kilemba cha kifalme katika kiganja cha Mungu wako.
sw.B: Utakuwa taji zuri lililoshikwa mkononi mwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kilemba cha mfalme kilichokaa katika kiganja cha Mungu wako.
sw.R: Utakuwa kama taji zuri ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analishika mkononi mwake. \q Utakuwa kama kilemba cha mfalme mkononi mwa Mungu wako.

decisions.choice: a crown in the hand of the LORD: Zion is God's treasured royal ornament, held and displayed by him
decisions.reason: A crown held in the hand is kept safe and shown with pride. In 28:5 the LORD is the crown of beauty for his people; here the image turns round, and Zion is his.

decisions.choice: a turban: the reading tradition (qere)
decisions.reason: The written text (ketiv) and the reading tradition (qere) spell this word differently. Both are the word for a turban or headband worn by a king or priest (compare 3:23; Zechariah 3:5), so the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: like a beautiful crown; like a king's turban
decisions.reason: Readable adds "like" so the picture is not read as Zion turning into an object.

source.text: לֹֽא־יֵאָמֵר֩ לָ֨ךְ ע֜וֹד עֲזוּבָ֗ה וּלְאַרְצֵךְ֙ לֹא־יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה כִּ֣י לָ֗ךְ יִקָּרֵא֙ חֶפְצִי־בָ֔הּ וּלְאַרְצֵ֖ךְ בְּעוּלָ֑ה כִּֽי־חָפֵ֤ץ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְאַרְצֵ֖ךְ תִּבָּעֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will it be said of you again, Abandoned, and of your land not will it be said again, Desolation; but to you it will be called, Hephzibah, and to your land, Beulah; for delights Yahweh in you, and your land will be married.

en.L: It will no longer be said of you, Abandoned, \q and of your land it will no longer be said, Desolation; \q but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} delights in you, \q and your land will be married.
en.B: No one will call you Abandoned any longer, \q or call your land Desolation. \q Instead you will be named She Is My Delight, and your land Wedded, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} delights in you, \q and your land will be taken as a bride.
en.R: People will not call you Abandoned anymore. \q They will not call your land Ruined. \q Your new name will be I Delight in Her, and your land will be called Married. \q That is because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with you, \q and your land will be like a married woman.

es.L: Nunca más se dirá de ti: Abandonada, \q ni de tu tierra se dirá más: Desolación; \q sino que te llamarán Hefzi-bá, y a tu tierra Beulá; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se deleita en ti, \q y tu tierra será desposada.
es.B: Nadie te llamará más Abandonada, \q ni llamará a tu tierra Desolación. \q En cambio te llamarán Mi Deleite Está en Ella, y a tu tierra Desposada, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se deleita en ti, \q y tu tierra será tomada como esposa.
es.R: La gente ya no te llamará Abandonada. \q No llamarán a tu tierra Arruinada. \q Tu nuevo nombre será Me Deleito en Ella, y tu tierra se llamará Casada. \q Esto es porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está contento contigo, \q y tu tierra será como una mujer casada.

fr.L: On ne te dira plus : Abandonnée, \q et de ton pays on ne dira plus : Désolation ; \q mais on t’appellera Hephtsiba, et ton pays Béoula ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} met {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plaisir en toi, \q et ton pays sera épousé.
fr.B: Personne ne t’appellera plus « Abandonnée », \q et personne n’appellera plus ton pays « Désolation ». \q Au contraire, on te nommera « Mon plaisir est en elle », et ton pays « Épousée », \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} met {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plaisir en toi, \q et ton pays sera pris pour épouse.
fr.R: Les gens ne t’appelleront plus « Abandonnée ». \q Ils n’appelleront plus ton pays « Ruiné ». \q Ton nouveau nom sera « Ma joie est en elle », et ton pays s’appellera « Mariée ». \q C’est parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est content de toi, \q et ton pays sera comme une femme mariée.

sw.L: Hutaitwa tena, Aliyeachwa, \q wala nchi yako haitaitwa tena, Ukiwa; \q bali utaitwa Hefziba, na nchi yako Beula; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapendezwa nawe, \q na nchi yako itaolewa.
sw.B: Hakuna atakayekuita tena Aliyeachwa, \q wala kuiita nchi yako Ukiwa. \q Badala yake utaitwa Furaha Yangu Iko Kwake, na nchi yako Aliyeolewa, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapendezwa nawe, \q na nchi yako itachukuliwa kama bibi arusi.
sw.R: Watu hawatakuita tena Aliyeachwa. \q Hawataiita nchi yako Iliyoharibiwa. \q Jina lako jipya litakuwa Ninapendezwa Naye, na nchi yako itaitwa Aliyeolewa. \q Hiyo ni kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapendezwa nawe, \q na nchi yako itakuwa kama mwanamke aliyeolewa.

decisions.choice: Hephzibah means "my delight is in her"; Beulah means "married" (a woman who has a husband)
decisions.reason: The new names answer the old ones. Abandoned is a wife left by her husband (54:6; 60:15), and Desolation is a land left empty (49:19; 54:1). Now God delights in Zion, and her land is like a wife with a husband. Hephzibah was also the name of King Hezekiah's wife (2 Kings 21:1).

decisions.choice: married: the land will be possessed, lived in and fruitful, like a wife with a husband
decisions.reason: An abandoned wife had no one to protect or provide for her, and an empty land produced nothing. The verb for marry also means to become master or owner, so a married land is one that has people who care for it. Verse 5 develops the picture.

decisions.choice: Literal keeps the names Hephzibah and Beulah; Balanced and Readable translate them
alternatives: My Delight Is in Her, Married at every level
decisions.reason: The names carry the meaning of the verse, and the reader needs to hear them against Abandoned and Desolation. Literal shows them as names; Balanced and Readable say what they mean.

decisions.choice: your land will be like a married woman
decisions.reason: Readable turns the verb into a plain comparison so the picture is clear.

decisions.choice: Hefzi-bá, Beulá (L); Mi Deleite Está en Ella, Desposada (B); Me Deleito en Ella, Casada (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew names in their usual Spanish form; Balanced and Readable translate them, as the English does, because the names carry the meaning of the verse.

decisions.choice: Hefziba, Beula (Literal); Furaha Yangu Iko Kwake, Aliyeolewa (Balanced); Ninapendezwa Naye, Aliyeolewa (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two Hebrew names in Swahili spelling; Balanced and Readable translate them, as the English does, so the reader hears them against Abandoned and Desolation (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "Hephtsiba", "Béoula"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two names in the French spelling of 2 Kings 21:1 ("Hephtsiba"); Balanced and Readable translate them and set the names in guillemets so they read as names.

source.text: כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֤ל בָּחוּר֙ בְּתוּלָ֔ה יִבְעָל֖וּךְ בָּנָ֑יִךְ וּמְשׂ֤וֹשׂ חָתָן֙ עַל־כַּלָּ֔ה יָשִׂ֥ישׂ עָלַ֖יִךְ אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For marries a young man a young woman, will marry you your sons; and [with the] joy of a bridegroom over a bride will rejoice over you your God.

en.L: For [as] a young man marries a young woman, \q your sons will marry you; \q and [with] the joy of a bridegroom over a bride \q your God will rejoice over you.
en.B: Your sons will take you \q as a young man takes a young woman in marriage; \q your God will be glad over you \q with a groom's joy over his bride.
en.R: As a young man marries a young woman, \q your children will marry you. That is, they will make their home in you. \q And your God will be as happy with you as a groom is with his bride.

es.L: Porque [como] el joven se casa con la doncella, \q se casarán contigo tus hijos; \q y [con] el gozo del novio por la novia \q se gozará por ti tu Dios.
es.B: Tus hijos te tomarán \q como un joven toma por esposa a una muchacha; \q tu Dios se alegrará por ti \q con la alegría del novio por su novia.
es.R: Como un joven se casa con una muchacha, \q tus hijos se casarán contigo. Es decir, harán de ti su hogar. \q Y tu Dios estará tan feliz contigo como un novio con su novia.

fr.L: Car [comme] un jeune homme épouse une jeune fille, \q tes fils t’épouseront ; \q et [de] la joie de l’époux pour l’épouse \q ton Dieu se réjouira de toi.
fr.B: Tes fils te prendront \q comme un jeune homme prend une jeune fille en mariage ; \q ton Dieu se réjouira de toi \q comme un époux se réjouit de sa fiancée.
fr.R: Comme un jeune homme épouse une jeune fille, \q tes enfants t’épouseront. Cela veut dire qu’ils viendront habiter chez toi. \q Et ton Dieu sera aussi heureux avec toi qu’un marié avec sa mariée.

sw.L: Kwa maana [kama] kijana amwoavyo msichana, \q ndivyo wana wako watakavyokuoa; \q na [kwa] furaha ya bwana arusi juu ya bibi arusi \q Mungu wako atakufurahia.
sw.B: Wana wako watakuoa \q kama kijana anavyomwoa msichana; \q Mungu wako atafurahi juu yako \q kwa furaha ya bwana arusi juu ya bibi arusi wake.
sw.R: Kama kijana anavyomwoa msichana, \q ndivyo watoto wako watakavyokuoa. Yaani, watafanya makao yao ndani yako. \q Na Mungu wako atafurahi nawe kama bwana arusi anavyomfurahia bibi arusi wake.

decisions.choice: your sons will marry you: Zion's own people will take possession of her and live in her
decisions.reason: The image is bold: Zion's returning children settle in her as a husband takes a wife, so she is no longer empty (49:20-21; 54:1-3). The same consonants could be read "your builder" (compare 49:17), which would make God the one who marries her, as in 54:5; the vowels of the received text read "your sons".

decisions.choice: the joy of a bridegroom over a bride: God's delight in his people
decisions.reason: The wedding picture continues from 61:10 and returns in 65:19 and Zephaniah 3:17, where God rejoices over his people with singing.

decisions.choice: That is, they will make their home in you.
decisions.reason: Readable explains the marriage picture, following the meaning decision on this phrase.

source.text: עַל־חוֹמֹתַ֣יִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הִפְקַ֨דְתִּי֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים כָּל־הַיּ֧וֹם וְכָל־הַלַּ֛יְלָה תָּמִ֖יד לֹ֣א יֶחֱשׁ֑וּ הַמַּזְכִּרִים֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה אַל־דֳּמִ֖י לָכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have appointed watchmen; all the day and all the night continually not they will be silent. [You] who cause to remember Yahweh, no rest [be] to you,

en.L: On your walls, Jerusalem, I have appointed watchmen; \q all the day and all the night continually they will not be silent. \q You who remind {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [take] no rest for yourselves,
en.B: I have stationed guards on your walls, Jerusalem; \q through the whole day and the whole night they will keep calling out, never silent. \q You who keep reminding {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q do not rest,
en.R: Jerusalem, I have put guards on your walls. \q They will call out all day and all night, and they will never be quiet. \q You who pray to remind {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} promises, \q do not rest.

es.L: Sobre tus muros, Jerusalén, he puesto centinelas; \q todo el día y toda la noche continuamente no callarán. \q Los que hacen recordar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q no {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} descanso,
es.B: He puesto guardias sobre tus muros, Jerusalén; \q todo el día y toda la noche seguirán clamando, sin callar nunca. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes que no dejan|Vosotros que no dejáis}} de recordarle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q no {{plural_you:descansen|descanséis}},
es.R: Jerusalén, he puesto guardias sobre tus muros. \q Clamarán todo el día y toda la noche, y nunca se quedarán callados. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes que oran|Vosotros que oráis}} para recordarle {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} promesas, \q no {{plural_you:descansen|descanséis}}.

fr.L: Sur tes murailles, Jérusalem, j’ai placé des guetteurs ; \q tout le jour et toute la nuit, continuellement, ils ne se tairont pas. \q Vous qui faites souvenir {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q ne prenez pas de repos,
fr.B: J’ai posté des gardes sur tes murailles, Jérusalem ; \q tout le jour et toute la nuit ils ne cesseront de crier, sans jamais se taire. \q Vous qui rappelez sans cesse {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q ne vous reposez pas,
fr.R: Jérusalem, j’ai mis des gardes sur tes murailles. \q Ils crieront jour et nuit, et ils ne se tairont jamais. \q Vous qui priez pour rappeler {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} promesses, \q ne vous reposez pas.

sw.L: Juu ya kuta zako, Yerusalemu, nimeweka walinzi; \q mchana kutwa na usiku kucha daima hawatanyamaza. \q Ninyi mnaomkumbusha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q msijipe pumziko,
sw.B: Nimeweka walinzi juu ya kuta zako, Yerusalemu; \q mchana wote na usiku wote wataendelea kupaza sauti, wasinyamaze kamwe. \q Ninyi mnaoendelea kumkumbusha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q msipumzike,
sw.R: Yerusalemu, nimeweka walinzi juu ya kuta zako. \q Wataita mchana kutwa na usiku kucha, wala hawatanyamaza kamwe. \q Ninyi mnaoomba ili kumkumbusha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ahadi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q msipumzike.

decisions.choice: watchmen who remind the LORD: people who pray without stopping, calling God's promises to his mind
decisions.reason: The watchmen do not guard against enemies here; they speak to God. The word for those who remind is the title of the royal recorder (36:3), whose task was to bring matters before the king. Prophets are called watchmen in 52:8, 56:10 and Ezekiel 3:17.

decisions.choice: I have appointed: the same unnamed speaker as in verse 1
decisions.reason: Whether this is the LORD or the prophet, the speaker who will not be silent (verse 1) now sets others on the walls who will not be silent either.

decisions.choice: take no rest: the command continues into verse 7
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on: they are to give themselves no rest and give God no rest until he acts.

decisions.choice: who pray to remind the LORD of his promises
decisions.reason: Readable says what reminding God means here; verse 7 shows the prayers are for God to do what he has promised for Jerusalem.

source.text: וְאַֽל־תִּתְּנ֥וּ דֳמִ֖י ל֑וֹ עַד־יְכוֹנֵ֞ן וְעַד־יָשִׂ֧ים אֶת־יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֛ם תְּהִלָּ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: and do not give rest to him until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

en.L: and do not give rest to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} establishes [her], and until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
en.B: and do not let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} rest either, \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made Jerusalem secure and made her a city the whole earth praises.
en.R: Do not let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} rest either. \q Keep on praying until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes Jerusalem strong again and makes her a city that people all over the world praise.

es.L: y no {{plural_you:le den|le deis}} descanso \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [la] establezca, y hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haga de Jerusalén una alabanza en la tierra.
es.B: y tampoco {{plural_you:lo dejen|le dejéis}} descansar a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} haya afirmado a Jerusalén y la haya hecho una ciudad que toda la tierra alabe.
es.R: Tampoco {{plural_you:lo dejen|le dejéis}} descansar a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q {{plural_you:Sigan|Seguid}} orando hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vuelva a hacer fuerte a Jerusalén y la haga una ciudad que la gente de todo el mundo alabe.

fr.L: et ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} laissez pas de repos \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [la] rétablisse, et jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse de Jérusalem une louange sur la terre.
fr.B: et ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} laissez pas de repos non plus, \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ait affermi Jérusalem et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en ait fait une ville que toute la terre loue.
fr.R: Ne {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} laissez pas se reposer non plus. \q Continuez à prier jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rende Jérusalem forte de nouveau et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en fasse une ville que les gens du monde entier admirent.

sw.L: wala msimpe pumziko \q mpaka [aufanye] imara, na mpaka aufanye Yerusalemu kuwa sifa duniani.
sw.B: wala msimwache apumzike pia, \q mpaka atakapoufanya Yerusalemu kuwa salama na kuufanya mji ambao dunia yote inausifu.
sw.R: Msimwache apumzike pia. \q Endeleeni kuomba mpaka atakapoufanya Yerusalemu kuwa imara tena na kuufanya mji ambao watu ulimwenguni kote wanausifu.

decisions.choice: give him no rest: pray to God without letting up
decisions.reason: The bold picture is of people who keep asking until God acts. Jesus tells a parable with the same point in Luke 18:1-8.

decisions.choice: a praise: something praised, a city others speak of with praise
decisions.reason: Jerusalem will be the object of the nations' praise (61:11; Jeremiah 33:9; Zephaniah 3:19-20).

decisions.choice: Keep on praying
decisions.reason: Readable repeats what the watchmen do, from verse 6, since Readable starts a new sentence here.

source.text: נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה בִּֽימִינ֖וֹ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ עֻזּ֑וֹ אִם־אֶתֵּן֩ אֶת־דְּגָנֵ֨ךְ ע֤וֹד מַֽאֲכָל֙ לְאֹ֣יְבַ֔יִךְ וְאִם־יִשְׁתּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־נֵכָר֙ תִּֽירוֹשֵׁ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגַ֖עַתְּ בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Has sworn Yahweh by his right hand and by [the] arm of his strength: If I will give your grain again [as] food to your enemies, and if will drink sons of foreignness your new wine for which you have labored,

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has sworn by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand and by the arm of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength: \q [Surely] I will no longer give your grain [as] food for your enemies, \q and foreigners will not drink your new wine for which you labored,
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has bound {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} by oath, by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strong arm: \q I will not let your enemies eat your grain any more, \q nor let outsiders drink the new wine you worked to make,
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made a serious promise, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has put all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power behind it. \q He said: I will not let your enemies eat your grain anymore. \q People from other lands will not drink the wine you worked hard to make.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha jurado por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} diestra y por el brazo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder: \q Nunca más daré tu grano [como] alimento a tus enemigos, \q ni beberán los extranjeros tu vino nuevo por el que trabajaste,
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se ha comprometido con juramento, por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano derecha y por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo poderoso: \q No dejaré más que tus enemigos coman tu grano, \q ni que los de fuera beban el vino nuevo que trabajaste para hacer,
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho una promesa solemne, y ha puesto todo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder detrás de ella. \q Dijo: No dejaré que tus enemigos coman más tu grano. \q La gente de otras tierras no beberá el vino que tanto trabajo te costó hacer.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite et par le bras de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force : \q [Jamais] plus je ne donnerai ton blé en nourriture à tes ennemis, \q et les fils de l’étranger ne boiront pas ton vin nouveau pour lequel tu as peiné,
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est engagé par serment, par {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main droite et par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras puissant : \q Je ne laisserai plus tes ennemis manger ton blé, \q ni des étrangers boire le vin nouveau que tu as eu tant de peine à faire,
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait une promesse solennelle, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} y a mis toute {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance. \q Il a dit : Je ne laisserai plus tes ennemis manger ton blé. \q Des gens d’autres pays ne boiront plus le vin que tu as eu tant de mal à faire.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameapa kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume na kwa mkono wa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}: \q [Hakika] sitaitoa tena nafaka yako [kuwa] chakula cha adui zako, \q wala wageni hawatakunywa divai yako mpya uliyoitaabikia,
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejifunga kwa kiapo, kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kuume na kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wenye nguvu: \q Sitawaacha tena adui zako wale nafaka yako, \q wala wageni wanywe divai mpya uliyotaabika kuitengeneza,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametoa ahadi nzito, naye ameweka uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote nyuma yake. \q Alisema: Sitawaacha tena adui zako wale nafaka yako. \q Watu kutoka nchi nyingine hawatakunywa divai uliyotaabika kuitengeneza.

decisions.choice: if I give ... if they drink: an oath form meaning "I will never again"
decisions.reason: In a Hebrew oath, "if I do this" leaves the curse on oneself unsaid and means "I will certainly not do it" (compare 14:24; Psalm 89:36).

decisions.choice: by his right hand and his strong arm: God pledges his own power
decisions.reason: People swear by something greater than themselves; God has nothing greater, so he swears by himself (45:23; Hebrews 6:13). His right hand and arm stand for his strength (40:10; 52:10).

decisions.choice: enemies eating the harvest: the old curse of invasion reversed
decisions.reason: Covenant curses warned that foreigners would eat what Israel had grown (Deuteronomy 28:33, 51; Judges 6:3-6). The promise is that this will not happen again.

decisions.choice: has made a serious promise, and he has put all his power behind it
decisions.reason: Readable explains what swearing by his right hand and arm means.

source.text: כִּ֤י מְאַסְפָיו֙ יֹאכְלֻ֔הוּ וְהִֽלְל֖וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וּֽמְקַבְּצָ֥יו יִשְׁתֻּ֖הוּ בְּחַצְר֥וֹת קָדְשִֽׁי׃ס

records.literal_gloss: but [those] gathering it will eat it, and will praise Yahweh; and [those] collecting it will drink it in [the] courts of my holiness.

en.L: but those who gather it will eat it and praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and those who collect it will drink it in the courts of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holiness.
en.B: no, the ones who reaped the grain will eat it, praising {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and the ones who picked the grapes will drink the wine in the courtyards of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy house.
en.R: Instead, the people who harvest the grain will eat it, and they will praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q The people who pick the grapes will drink the wine in the courtyards of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} Temple.

es.L: sino que los que lo recojan lo comerán y alabarán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y los que lo cosechen lo beberán en los atrios de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santidad.
es.B: no, los que cosecharon el grano lo comerán, alabando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, \q y los que recogieron las uvas beberán el vino en los atrios de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santa casa.
es.R: Al contrario, la gente que cosecha el grano lo comerá, y alabará {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. \q La gente que recoge las uvas beberá el vino en los patios de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo.

fr.L: mais ceux qui l’auront récolté le mangeront et loueront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et ceux qui l’auront recueilli le boiront dans les parvis de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} sainteté.
fr.B: non, ceux qui ont moissonné le blé le mangeront en louant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et ceux qui ont vendangé boiront le vin dans les parvis de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} sainte maison.
fr.R: Au contraire, les gens qui récoltent le blé le mangeront, et ils loueront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Les gens qui cueillent le raisin boiront le vin dans les cours de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple.

sw.L: bali wale wanaoivuna wataila na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na wale wanaoikusanya watainywa katika nyua za patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}}.
sw.B: la, wale waliovuna nafaka wataila, wakimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na wale waliochuma zabibu watakunywa divai katika nyua za nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} takatifu.
sw.R: Badala yake, watu wanaovuna nafaka wataila, nao watamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Watu wanaochuma zabibu watakunywa divai katika nyua za hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.

decisions.choice: eating and drinking in the courts of the sanctuary: the harvest enjoyed at God's festivals
decisions.reason: The Law told Israel to eat the tithe of grain and wine in the place God chose, rejoicing before him (Deuteronomy 12:17-18; 14:22-26). Those who grew the food will now enjoy it in worship.

decisions.choice: my: the LORD is still speaking, finishing the oath begun in verse 8
decisions.reason: The courts are God's own holy courts in the temple.

decisions.choice: the grain, the grapes, the wine
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name what is gathered and drunk, from verse 8, where Hebrew uses only "it".

source.text: עִבְר֤וּ עִבְרוּ֙ בַּשְּׁעָרִ֔ים פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָעָ֑ם סֹ֣לּוּ סֹ֤לּוּ הַֽמְסִלָּה֙ סַקְּל֣וּ מֵאֶ֔בֶן הָרִ֥ימוּ נֵ֖ס עַל־הָעַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Pass through, pass through in the gates; clear the way of the people; build up, build up the highway; clear [it] of stone[s]; lift up a signal flag over the peoples.

en.L: Pass through, pass through the gates; \q clear the way of the people; \q build up, build up the highway; clear [it] of stones; \q raise a signal flag over the peoples.
en.B: Through the gates, go through! \q Open a road for the people! \q Pile it up, pile up the highway, and pick out the stones! \q Lift a signal flag high over the peoples!
en.R: Go out through the city gates! \q Get a road ready for God's people to travel on. \q Build a highway, and clear away the stones. \q Put up a signal flag so the nations can see it.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Pasen, pasen|Pasad, pasad}} por las puertas; \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} el camino del pueblo; \q {{plural_you:allanen, allanen|allanad, allanad}} la calzada; {{plural_you:quítenle|quitadle}} las piedras; \q {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} una bandera sobre los pueblos!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Pasen|Pasad}} por las puertas, {{plural_you:pasen|pasad}}! \q ¡{{plural_you:Abran|Abrid}} un camino para el pueblo! \q ¡{{plural_you:Levanten, levanten|Levantad, levantad}} la calzada, y {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} las piedras! \q ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} bien alto una bandera sobre los pueblos!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Salgan|Salid}} por las puertas de la ciudad! \q {{plural_you:Preparen|Preparad}} un camino para que el pueblo de Dios pueda viajar. \q {{plural_you:Construyan|Construid}} una calzada, y {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} las piedras. \q {{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}} una bandera para que las naciones la vean.

fr.L: Passez, passez par les portes ; \q préparez le chemin du peuple ; \q remblayez, remblayez la route ; ôtez-[en] les pierres ; \q élevez un étendard sur les peuples.
fr.B: Passez les portes, passez-les ! \q Frayez un chemin pour le peuple ! \q Élevez, élevez la grande route, ôtez-en les pierres ! \q Dressez bien haut un étendard au-dessus des peuples !
fr.R: Sortez par les portes de la ville ! \q Préparez une route pour que le peuple de Dieu puisse voyager. \q Construisez une grande route, et enlevez les pierres. \q Levez un drapeau pour que les nations le voient.

sw.L: Piteni, piteni katika malango; \q tengenezeni njia ya watu; \q tueni, tueni barabara kuu; iondoleeni mawe; \q inueni bendera juu ya watu wa mataifa.
sw.B: Pitieni malangoni, piteni! \q Fungueni njia kwa ajili ya watu! \q Ijengeni, ijengeni juu barabara kuu, na kuyaokota mawe! \q Inueni bendera juu kwa ajili ya mataifa!
sw.R: Tokeni nje kupitia malango ya mji! \q Tengenezeni barabara kwa ajili ya watu wa Mungu kusafiri. \q Jengeni barabara kuu, na kuondoa mawe. \q Simamisheni bendera ili mataifa yaione.

decisions.choice: pass through the gates: probably Jerusalem's gates, going out to prepare the way for those returning
decisions.reason: The commands are plural, to people in the city. The gates may instead be those of Babylon, as the exiles are told to go out from there (48:20; 52:11). Either way, the road is for God's people coming home.

decisions.choice: clear the way, build up the highway, raise a signal flag: the road home announced in earlier chapters
decisions.reason: The words repeat 40:3 and 57:14 (build up, build up, clear the way) and 11:12 and 49:22, where a signal flag is raised to the nations to bring Israel's scattered people home.

decisions.choice: God's people
decisions.reason: Readable says whose people they are; the road is for Israel returning to Zion (verse 11).

source.text: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה הִשְׁמִ֨יעַ֙ אֶל־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אִמְרוּ֙ לְבַת־צִיּ֔וֹן הִנֵּ֥ה יִשְׁעֵ֖ךְ בָּ֑א הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, Yahweh has proclaimed to [the] end of the earth: Say to [the] daughter of Zion, Look, your salvation comes; look, his wages [are] with him, and his recompense before him.

en.L: Look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has proclaimed to the end of the earth: \q Say to the daughter of Zion, \q "Look, your salvation comes; \q look, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wages [are] with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} recompense [is] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: See, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has announced to the farthest parts of the earth: \q Tell Daughter Zion, \q "Look, your salvation is coming! \q Look, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} prize with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won goes ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Listen! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has announced this to the whole world: \q Tell the people of Zion, "Look! The one who saves you is coming. \q Look! He is bringing with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the reward {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has won. \q What {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has earned goes in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."

es.L: Mira, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha proclamado hasta el extremo de la tierra: \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} a la hija de Sion: \q «Mira, tu salvación viene; \q mira, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} recompensa [está] con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} galardón delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.B: Mira, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha anunciado hasta los lugares más lejanos de la tierra: \q {{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} a la hija de Sion: \q «¡Mira, tu salvación está llegando! \q Mira, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} trae consigo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} premio; \q lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ganado va delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.R: ¡Escucha! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha anunciado esto a todo el mundo: \q {{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} al pueblo de Sion: «¡Mira! Viene el que te salva. \q ¡Mira! Trae consigo la recompensa que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha ganado. \q Lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha conseguido va delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

fr.L: Voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a proclamé jusqu’à l’extrémité de la terre : \q Dites à la fille de Sion : \q « Voici, ton salut vient ; \q voici, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salaire [est] avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} rétribution devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.B: Voyez, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a annoncé jusqu’au bout de la terre : \q Dites à la fille de Sion : \q « Voici, ton salut arrive ! \q Voici, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} apporte avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} récompense, \q et ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a gagné le précède. »
fr.R: Écoutez ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a annoncé ceci au monde entier : \q Dites au peuple de Sion : « Regarde ! Celui qui te sauve arrive. \q Regarde ! Il apporte avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} la récompense qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a gagnée. \q Ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a gagné marche devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »

sw.L: Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametangaza hadi mwisho wa dunia: \q Mwambieni binti Sayuni, \q "Tazama, wokovu wako unakuja; \q tazama, ujira {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} [uko] pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}, \q na malipo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} [yako] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.B: Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametangaza hadi sehemu za mbali kabisa za dunia: \q Mwambieni Binti Sayuni, \q "Tazama, wokovu wako unakuja! \q Tazama, analeta zawadi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}; \q kile alichokishinda kinatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."
sw.R: Sikilizeni! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ametangaza jambo hili kwa ulimwengu wote: \q Waambieni watu wa Sayuni, "Tazama! Yeye anayewaokoa anakuja. \q Tazama! Analeta pamoja {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} zawadi aliyoishinda. \q Kile alichokipata kinatangulia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}."

decisions.choice: your salvation comes; his reward is with him: salvation here is God himself coming to save
decisions.reason: Salvation is spoken of as a person who comes and brings a reward, so it stands for the LORD who saves. The Septuagint has "your Savior". The words about the reward repeat 40:10, where the Lord GOD comes with his reward; Revelation 22:12 takes them up.

decisions.choice: say to the daughter of Zion: the words Matthew 21:5 uses for Jesus' entry into Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Matthew joins these opening words to Zechariah 9:9, "your king is coming to you".

decisions.choice: wages and recompense: what God has won, the people he has rescued
alternatives: the reward he gives his people
decisions.reason: As in 40:10, the reward is what the victor brings back, here the redeemed people of verse 12.

decisions.choice: the people of Zion
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who "daughter of Zion" is: the people of the city.

decisions.choice: the one who saves you
decisions.reason: Readable follows the meaning decision that salvation here stands for God coming as Savior, since the next line says "he".

decisions.choice: Digan a la hija de Sion
decisions.reason: Matthew 21:5 opens with these words; Spanish keeps "la hija de Sion", as the published verse, with the plural_you span on the command.

source.text: וְקָרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם עַם־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלָךְ֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א דְרוּשָׁ֔ה עִ֖יר לֹ֥א נֶעֱזָֽבָה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they will call them the people of the holiness, [the] redeemed of Yahweh; and to you it will be called Sought-After, a city not abandoned.

en.L: And they will call them The Holy People, The Redeemed of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q and you will be called Sought After, A City Not Abandoned.
en.B: They will be named The Holy People, Those {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} Has Redeemed, \q and you will be named Sought After, The City Not Abandoned.
en.R: People will call them The Holy People and The People {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} Has Bought Back. \q And you, Jerusalem, will be called Sought After and The City Not Abandoned.

es.L: Y los llamarán Pueblo Santo, Redimidos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; \q y a ti te llamarán Buscada, Ciudad No Abandonada.
es.B: Serán llamados el Pueblo Santo, los que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Ha Redimido, \q y a ti te llamarán Buscada, la Ciudad No Abandonada.
es.R: La gente los llamará El Pueblo Santo y El Pueblo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Ha Rescatado. \q Y a ti, Jerusalén, te llamarán Buscada y La Ciudad No Abandonada.

fr.L: Et on les appellera Peuple saint, Rachetés {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; \q et toi, on t’appellera Recherchée, Ville non abandonnée.
fr.B: On les nommera « le Peuple saint », « Ceux que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rachetés », \q et toi, on te nommera « Recherchée », « la Ville qui n’est pas abandonnée ».
fr.R: Les gens les appelleront « le Peuple saint » et « le Peuple que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a racheté ». \q Et toi, Jérusalem, on t’appellera « Recherchée » et « la Ville qui n’est pas abandonnée ».

sw.L: Nao watawaita Watu Watakatifu, Waliokombolewa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nawe utaitwa Uliyetafutwa, Mji Usioachwa.
sw.B: Wataitwa Watu Watakatifu, Wale Ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Amewakomboa, \q nawe utaitwa Uliyetafutwa, Mji Usioachwa.
sw.R: Watu watawaita Watu Watakatifu na Watu Ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Amewanunua Tena. \q Nawe, Yerusalemu, utaitwa Uliyetafutwa na Mji Usioachwa.

decisions.choice: Sought After: cared for and longed for, no longer neglected
decisions.reason: The word means sought out, looked after. It reverses the taunt of Jeremiah 30:17, "Zion, whom no one cares for" (the same verb).

decisions.choice: The Holy People, The Redeemed of the LORD: the titles of Israel at the exodus, given again
decisions.reason: Israel was called to be a holy nation (Exodus 19:6; Deuteronomy 7:6). The redeemed of the LORD return to Zion in 35:9-10 and 51:10-11. 1 Peter 2:9 applies the titles to the church.

decisions.choice: A City Not Abandoned: the answer to the old name Abandoned in verse 4
decisions.reason: The chapter ends by undoing the name it began to undo; the same verb is used.

decisions.choice: you, Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Readable names the city addressed, since the verse moves from "them" (the people) to "you" (Zion).
